title: Citta Games
shortDescription: Real Money & social gaming platform featuring classic multiplayer titles like Ludo, Carrom, and Tic Tac Toe with payment gateway integrations (Razorpay, PhonePe, Cashfree).
fullDescription: Engineered a scalable multi-game Real Money Gaming (RMG) platform supporting synchronous real-time multiplayer titles. Developed custom native Android and iOS plugins to integrate payment gateways (Razorpay, PhonePe, Cashfree) and enterprise SDKs (Firebase, PlayFab, Adjust, AppsFlyer, Freshchat, Apple/Google Login). Architected modular game mechanics using Git submodules for seamless engine reuse.

keyLearnings: End-to-end Real Money Gaming architecture, native platform plugin development (Android/iOS), payment gateway security flows, and live SDK orchestration.
